simple.meaning: קָצִין (qâtsîyn) appears 12 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Joshua, Judges, Proverbs, Isaiah, Daniel, and 1 more, beginning at Joshua 10:24. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָצִין (H7101) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows קָצִין through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: קָצִין (qâtsîyn) / H7101 is tracked through Joshua 10:24, Judges 11:6, Judges 11:11, Proverbs 6:7. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

timeline.evidenceText: When they brought those kings out to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the chiefs of the men of war who went with him, “Come near. Put your feet on the necks of these kings.”
They said to Jephthah, “Come and be our chief, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.”
Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and chief over them. Jephthah spoke all his words before Yahweh in Mizpah.
which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
By patience a ruler is persuaded.
Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom!
Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying,
In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer;
All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.
After this he will turn his face to the islands, and will take many; but a prince will cause the reproach offered by him to cease. Yes, moreover, he will cause his reproach to turn on him.
Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob,

definitions.short: a magistrate (as deciding ) or other leader
definitions.full: H7101. qatsin קָצִין noun masculine Dan 11:18 chief, ruler (properly decider , compare Dr 11:8 ); — absolute ׳ק Judg 11:6 +; construct קְצִּין Isa 3:7 ; plural construct קְעִינֵי Isaiah 1:40 +; suffix קְצִינַיִח 22:3 ; — 1 chief, commander in war Josh 10:24 (JE), Judg 11:6 , 11 (|| ראֹשׁ ), Dan 11:18 . 2 dictator , Isaiah 3:67. 3 more Generally, ruler , man in authority, Isa 1:10 ; 22:3 ; Micah 3:1 , 9 ; of ants, ק ׳אֵין Prov 6:7 (+ משֵׁל שֹׁטֵר, ). — 25:15 read probably קֶצֶף (Toy). קְצָוֺת see קְצָת . above קצח (√ of following; meaning unknown; Late Hebrew קֶצַח = Biblical Hebrew; Arabic , seeds used for seasoning ).
